item.title: McBride has 21, James Madison defeats Appalachian State 69-58
item.description: Led by Justin McBride's 21 points, the James Madison Dukes defeated the Appalachian State Mountaineers 69-58 on Saturday.

item.title: Somerville scores 23 to help Florida State cruise past Virginia Tech, 92-69
item.description: Martin Somerville scored an efficient 23 points along with six assists as Florida State rolled past Virginia Tech 92-69 on Saturday.

item.title: Thomas, Lewis help No. 15 Virginia beat Ohio State 70-66 in Nashville
item.description: Malik Thomas and Sam Lewis each scored 13 points and No. 15 Virginia beat Ohio State 70-66 on Saturday night at Bridgestone Arena in the Nashville Hoops Showdown.
